name: heff
description: heff: Lynch & Staton's Hippogriff, with a text-based toolchain

scripts.build: spago build && node bin/heff.mjs compile-js fmt/layout.hf output/heff-fmt.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node test/surface.mjs && node test/format.mjs && node test/cache.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node test/lsp.mjs && node test/app-run.mjs && node test/node-run.mjs && node test/compile-check-js.mjs 60 1 && node test/fmt-port.mjs && node test/nbe-port.mjs && node test/selfhost-port.mjs && node test/self-check.mjs && node test/gen-fixpoint.mjs && node test/watch-port.mjs && node test/check-port.mjs && node test/cli-port.mjs && node test/cache-port.mjs
